document: Angel Funds under the IFSCA FM Regulations (IFSCA Circular, 1 Jul 2022)

how_to_read.required: Obligations a careful human reader should extract from the clause. Matched by clause number and modality.
how_to_read.optional: Borderline items (e.g. a second sentence some labellers would merge). Matching them counts neither for nor against.
how_to_read.threshold: Present only where the clause states one explicit numeric limit. Describes a compliant value. Used for threshold accuracy.
how_to_read.clauses not listed: Contain no obligation (definitions, applicability, exemptions, sub-conditions).

optional.note: other FM Regulations provisions apply (applicability, not a duty)

required.note: invest only in early-stage VC undertakings or regulated angel schemes/funds
no investment in associates of the FME or connected undertakings
obtain express consent from every contributing angel investor before investing
structure each investment as a close-ended segregated portfolio
ring-fence assets and liabilities of each segregated portfolio
launch by filing a placement memorandum with fees

optional.note: filing is under the green channel (procedure)

required.note: intimate investments in early-stage undertakings within 10 working days
intimate investments in other angel schemes/funds within 10 working days
inform material changes immediately
max 200 angel investors per segregated portfolio
no commitment below USD 40,000 per angel investor

optional.note: invest the commitment across portfolios within 5 years

required.note: each investment max USD 1,500,000
lock-in of at least 1 year
corpus of at least USD 1,000,000
FME contribution of the lower of 2.5% or USD 20,000 (combined limit: no single threshold)
contribution made by FME or associate and maintained on an ongoing basis
no leverage
may invest above USD 1,500,000 in subsequent rounds, subject to conditions
offer subsequent rounds only to earlier participants
limit contribution so beneficial interest stays the same
overall exposure max 50% or USD 30,000,000 whichever lower (combined limit)
comply with all other segregated-portfolio conditions
pay USD 3,000 fee when filing the placement memorandum
pay USD 500 fee when filing an intimation
